_readme: Which model does which job in t3-team. Designed by claude-fable-5-2 on 2026-11-23 from config/models.json (benchmarks) and the learn-anything run (fix rounds, stalls, review proofs).
models: aliases -> T3 delegate_task target (driver = providerInstanceId, model id, options) + model family + cost class.
roles: where the job runs (leader thread or a delegate), the primary alias, the fallback chain, and why. src: run = evidence from a real run, prior = models.json benchmarks, guess = no evidence yet.
review: per tier, candidates in order; the leader takes the first available one whose family differs from the implementer that actually ran.
Edit this file to change assignments permanently; per run use a Standing order, per ticket say it in the plan proposal. Check edits with roles_check.py.

leader.why: Interview, ticket split, proof reruns and merge questions need the user and the thread context; picking the few questions that change scope, architecture, cost or done is a judgement job. Never Fable (reserved for architecture).

interviewer.why: A delegate cannot talk to the user.

architect.why: Options table and design.md draft for large or cross-module changes only; Arena and AA rank 1; the user reserves Fable for architecture. Returns options plus only the questions that change scope, architecture, cost or done. Small changes: the leader drafts.

plan_audit.why: astra's findings in the learn-anything run were reproducible (7 of 7 proofs rerun by the leader).

research.why: hydrogen found 9 relevant repos with licences; spends no Claude or Codex quota. Web only.

impl_A.why: TB4 rank 1; 5 tier-A tickets, no stalls.

impl_B.why: LR 1, LX 2, LB 0, LP 0 fix rounds; sonnet did LC in 1 round after the stall.

impl_C.why: TB4 equal to Haiku at about a fifth of the price. Paid: needs the user's yes; otherwise start at haiku. Never ran in T3.

ui_AB.why: Arena rank 2; rank 1 is Fable, which is reserved.

migration.why: Irreversible work: never tier C, always two reviewers.

fix_round.why: t3_thread_send keeps the worktree and context.

rules.mandatory_ticket_line: Run checks inside your normal sandbox; never request escalated permissions.
